resources.string: Automatically switch EQ, AutoEq, Spatial, 8D & Loudness for each headset, DAC or speaker
Changes in Equalizer and Audio FX are remembered per output device, switched automatically on connect/disconnect, and synced via Mochy Cloud & offline backup.
Mobile data · Prioritising fast streams (Zing MP3 / YouTube)
Auto-picks the best source by network & song language
Prefer Monochrome / Apple Music lossless on Wi-Fi, Zing MP3 / YouTube Music on 4G/5G
Prioritise Zing MP3 for Vietnamese music
Detect Vietnamese diacritics & artists and route Zing MP3 → YouTube Music first
Reuse each song\'s best working provider (%1$d remembered)
Only switches between providers you already enabled. Failed sources fall back automatically to the next one in order.
Space out tracks by the same artist and mix favorites with songs you haven\'t heard in a while
Avoids playing the same artist back-to-back, balances familiar hits with rediscovery tracks, and gently pushes frequently skipped tracks further back.
Tracks skipped in the first 15s drop in Radio/Autoplay; replayed tracks rank higher
Runs 100% on-device. Skipping within 15 seconds lowers a song\'s priority in Radio, Autoplay and Smart Shuffle, while replaying boosts it.
Hide translation on Vietnamese songs; auto-translate EN/JA/KO/ZH to Vietnamese & auto-romanize JA/KO/ZH

Automatically detects each song\'s lyric language: hides translation and romanization on Vietnamese tracks, turns on Vietnamese translation for English/Japanese/Korean/Chinese tracks, and turns on Romaji/Romanization/Pinyin for Japanese/Korean/Chinese. Manual toggles on the current song are still respected.
Auto-hide on Vietnamese · auto-translate & romanize foreign tracks
